text: The proper mean to observe in this case will be to make no change in what is past... in all future elections, however, to pursue the directions of the Pompeian law: for to give it a retrospective operation would necessarily introduce great confusion.
author: Trajan, Roman emperor
locator: Correspondence with Trajan, Letter CXVI, Trajan to Pliny
translation: William Melmoth, rev. F. C. T. Bosanquet
